title: Online Conformal Anomaly Detection with Prediction-Powered Data Acquisition
abstract: arXiv:2505.01783v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Online anomaly detection is essential in fields such as cybersecurity, healthcare, industrial monitoring, and telecommunications, where promptly identifying deviations from expected behavior can avert critical failures or security breaches. While numerous anomaly scoring methods based on supervised or unsupervised learning have been proposed, the only existing approach capable of providing assumption-free guarantees on the false discovery rate (FDR) rely on a continuous stream of real-world calibration data. To address this limitation, we introduce context-aware prediction-powered conformal online anomaly detection (C-PP-COAD), a novel principled framework that strategically leverages synthetic calibration data to mitigate data scarcity, while adaptively integrating real data based on contextual information. translated_title: 基于预测增强数据采集的在线保形异常检测
translated_abstract: 在线异常检测在网络安全、医疗保健、工业监控和电信等领域至关重要，在这些领域中，及时识别与预期行为的偏差可以避免关键故障或安全漏洞。尽管已有许多基于监督或无监督学习的异常评分方法被提出，但唯一能够在错误发现率（FDR）上提供无假设保证的现有方法依赖于连续的真实世界校准数据流。为解决这一局限性，我们引入了上下文感知的预测增强保形在线异常检测（C-PP-COAD），这是一种新颖的原则性框架，它策略性地利用合成校准数据来缓解数据稀缺问题，同时根据上下文信息自适应地整合真实数据。C-PP-COAD可包裹任何现有的异常检测方法，利用任意给定的异常评分来构建主动保形机制。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为C-PP-COAD的新框架，通过结合合成数据和上下文信息实现预测增强的在线异常检测，在无需依赖连续真实数据的情况下提供错误发现率保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework called C-PP-COAD that leverages synthetic data and contextual information for prediction-powered online anomaly detection, providing FDR guarantees without relying on continuous real-world data.
